<thought>The monoisotopic peak at m/z 100.0524 matches the exact mass of C₅H₈O₂ (5 C = 60.0000, 8 H ≈ 8.0626, 2 O ≈ 31.9898 → total ≈ 100.0524). The observed isotopic pattern (≈5.6 % M+1, ≈0.5 % M+2) is consistent with five carbons (13C) and two oxygens (including 18O). Therefore the molecular formula is C5H8O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C5H8O2</final_answer>
